# Subregion — Entanglement Entropy

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “subregion duality holography”).

claims.name: subregion_duality_realized_within_framework
claims.statement: Subregion duality is realized within the framework of bilocal holography.

claims.name: holographic_quantum_errorcorrecting_codes_capture
claims.statement: Holographic quantum error-correcting codes capture key features of holography, including subregion duality, operator reconstruction, and complementary recovery, by encoding bulk information into highly entangled boundary degrees of freedom.

sources.title: Angular $k$-uniformity and the Hyperinvariance of Holographic Codes

claims.name: essay_offers_reviewstyle_synthesis_how
claims.statement: This essay offers a review-style synthesis of how de Sitter holography departs from the better-understood AdS/CFT picture. It emphasizes that the boundary interpretation of Wheeler-DeWitt states is unclear in de Sitter, bulk reconstruction and subregion duality do not transfer straightforwardly from AdS/CFT, and a formulation of emergence and subregion-subalgebra duality in de Sitter is still lacking.

claims.name: paper_derives_remarkably_local_bulk
claims.statement: The paper derives a remarkably local bulk reconstruction formula within bilocal holography and shows that, after matching boundary data and gauge-fixed variables, it agrees with standard bulk reconstruction. It also clarifies how subregion duality is realized in this gauge-fixed higher-spin holographic framework.

claims.name: paper_proposes_hyperbolic_fracton_models
claims.statement: The paper proposes hyperbolic fracton models with subsystem symmetry as classical toy models for holography and shows that they reproduce key holographic features on a hyperbolic lattice. For connected boundary regions, the model realizes the expected subregion duality and a geometric Ryu-Takayanagi relation for mutual information.

sources.title: Hyperbolic Fracton Model, Subsystem Symmetry, and Holography

claims.name: paper_proposes_subregionsubalgebra_duality_general
claims.statement: The paper proposes subregion-subalgebra duality for general causally complete bulk regions in holography, giving a framework for how spacetime subregions, time notions, and causal structure emerge from the dual CFT. It sharpens entanglement-wedge reconstruction with an entropy-free, mathematically precise formulation and explains wedge geometry through superadditivity of boundary algebras.

sources.title: Subregion-subalgebra duality: emergence of space and time in holography
